description.value:
Some scouts hunt alone; followers of the Predator Technique understand that a pack brings down prey no lone wolf ever could. They specialize in drawing an enemy's attention just long enough for their allies to deliver the killing blow.

Built around teamwork rather than solitary glory, a Predator directs a strike the instant an opening appears, shares resilience with the rest of the pack, and makes sure a wounded target has nowhere left to hide. Their gift isn't personal power, it's turning every ally nearby into a more dangerous hunter.
